landing.title: GitHub Actions insights and management, self-hosted
landing.intro: DevOps Manager connects to your repositories through one GitHub App and shows runs, durations, queue times, runners and costs across a personal account and organisations.
landing.privacy: Normalised run and job metadata, logins of GitHub actors, the email, name and groups snapshot of app users, and audit entries. Raw run data is kept for 90 days by default; daily rollups are kept. Logs and secrets are never stored.
landing.selfHost: Deploy on Vercel with Neon, or run it with Docker Compose.

adminGithub.title: GitHub billing credentials
adminGithub.intro: GitHub's billing usage report of a personal account needs a user token. Without a credential, the costs of a personal account are estimates. Organisations use the installation token (organisation permission Administration: read) and need nothing here.
adminGithub.envNote: GITHUB_BILLING_TOKEN is set and applies to this installation. It is never stored; remove the variable to manage the credential here.
adminGithub.reconnectBanner: The authorisation was revoked or has expired. Reconnect GitHub or store a token to get billed figures again.

optionA.title: Option A: store a token
optionA.description: A fine-grained personal access token of {account} with the account permission Plan: read. It is checked with GitHub, stored encrypted and used only for billing.

optionB.title: Option B: Connect GitHub
optionB.description: {account} authorises the App on GitHub (user-to-server token with refresh-token rotation). Be signed in on GitHub as {account} before you continue.
optionB.notConfigured: Set GITHUB_CONNECT_ENABLED=true, GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET to enable this option.

revoke.title: Remove the credential
revoke.description: Deletes the stored token and revokes a connected authorisation on GitHub. Costs fall back to estimates.

connect.denied: The authorisation was cancelled on GitHub.
